name: Precise Expressions Admin Menu Reorganizer Lite
author: preciseexpressions

sections.description:
Precise Expressions Admin Menu Reorganizer Lite helps you tame the chaos of the WordPress dashboard. It is designed for shop managers and developers who want a cleaner, more logical backend interface.

Simplify Your WordPress & WooCommerce Admin Menus

If you manage a WooCommerce store or build sites for clients, the left-hand admin menu can quickly become overwhelmed with plugin settings and notifications. This lightweight, framework-free tool allows you to hide unnecessary items, group similar menus, and create a focused workspace.

Lite Features

  • Catalog Hub for WooCommerce (built-in): Instantly declutters your e-commerce dashboard by adding a visual Catalog hub under WooCommerce with quick links to Products, Categories, Orders, Payments, Analytics, and Marketing.
  • Custom Rule Builder: From Settings > Precise Expressions Admin Menu Reorganizer Lite, create up to two custom menu rules to move top-level admin items under a selected parent menu.
  • Comments Cleanup (built-in): Automatically moves the Comments menu item inside Posts to reduce root-level menu clutter.
  • Smart Alias Redirects: Keeps moved items usable by safely redirecting aliases to their new destination screens.
  • Lightweight and Safe: No heavy drag-and-drop dependencies, and guaranteed clean removal upon uninstall.

Unlock Unlimited Control with Pro

Need full control over every dashboard item? Upgrade to Admin Menu Reorganizer Pro to unlock:
* Unlimited Rules: Create an unlimited number of custom organization rules.
* Advanced Flyout Menus: Build larger grouped structures for Settings, Tools, Plugins, and other admin sections.
* WooCommerce Cleanup: Consolidate WooCommerce sections like Analytics, Marketing, and Payments into a cleaner structure.
* Broader Plugin Taming: Move third-party plugin menus out of the top-level sidebar for a more focused admin experience.
* Professional Icons: Assign custom icons to your newly consolidated menus.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the precise-expressions-admin-menu-reorganizer-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Precise Expressions Admin Menu Reorganizer Lite to view the active features and build your rules.
sections.faq:
Does this delete my menus?

No. It simply hides or moves them. If you deactivate the plugin, everything returns to normal immediately.

Can I customize the menu order manually?

Yes. The Lite version includes a settings-page rule builder that lets you add up to 2 custom menu rules, plus the built-in Comments and Catalog features. The Pro version removes the 2-rule cap and supports unlimited custom rules and advanced grouping.
